page.layout: One printed page: a single main text column with two narrow margin columns on the left. Nothing under the text. The right edge shows a fragment of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ad Imperatorem, [o Tom.2. Bib.Sancta.{o} Gloriosissimo Constantio Augusto &c. Opto tranquillissime Imperator,ut mihi benignas aures Clementia tua tribuat, quo possim manfuetudini tuæ mentis meæ propositum aperire &c.] Nec ita multò post,ut ad pristinam dignitatem restitueretur Arriano dogmati subscripsit, fatente Hieronymo, Hilario, Sozomeno,Epiphanio,& ipso Cæsare Baronio (utcunq; turpissimum hunc lapsum ab infamia vindicare tanquam pro aris & focis contendat.) Porrò p Tom.2. Bib.Sancta.{p} Cyrillus Archiepiscopus Hierosolimitanus,ipse ab Arrianis etiam miserè vexatus, in hunc modum Imperatori scribit. Imperatori Deo dilectissimo & pientissimo Constantio Augusto &c. concludens tandem his verbis: ipse Rex, omnium Deus, totius beneficentiæ exhibitor, multis annorum periodis, ad honorem & gloriam Christianis mundoq; universo te servet incolumem, potentioremque te efficiat,& omni ornatum virtute, ut pro more sanctarum Ecclesiarum Imperatoris Romani humanitatem demonstres,& amplioribus pietatis coronis in multos annorum cir-culos

page.notes: The two margin notes stand left of the text: "o Tom.2. Bib.Sancta." and "p Tom.2. Bib.Sancta.". "Arrianis" is set in italic in the scan. Its "Arriano" earlier looks roman. Some letters of the text are faint in the scan, but all words were legible. The fragment at the right edge belongs to the next page and is not transcribed.
